**Paenitentiam Agere** is actually a papal encyclical (not a musical work), authored by **Pope John XXIII**, who issued it on July 1, 1962.

Pope John XXIII died in his apartment within the **Vatican Apostolic Palace** in **Vatican City** on June 3, 1963.

**Vatican City became its own independent sovereign state on February 11, 1929**, when the Lateran Treaty was signed between Italy and the Holy See. The treaty officially took effect on **June 7, 1929**. This agreement resolved the "Roman Question" - the dispute over papal territories after Italy's unification in 1870, during which Popes had declared themselves "prisoners in the Vatican."

So, the place of death of *Paenitentiam Agere*'s author (Vatican City) became its own country on **February 11, 1929** (with full legal effect from June 7, 1929).
